children: Bolivian Attorney General Roger Mariaca has been arrested two days after the US accused him of receiving bribes, the country's Interior Minister Marco Antonio Oviedo said on Thursday.

Mariaca was arrested along with 13 other people on Wednesday as part of an operation targeting a a “criminal organization” reportedly entrenched in the judiciary and the Public Prosecutor’s Office, Oviedo said.
